title: Misconception Registry Entry
description: A first-class misconception object in the shared registry (core design doc §2.4). Each entry points back into the skill graph, so a wrong answer is evidence for a specific broken prerequisite, not a −1 on a score.

misconception_id.description: Registry identifier, e.g. MISC.FRAC.ADD-ACROSS. Internal vocabulary — humans only ever see parent_summary_i18n.

belief.description: The faulty rule the student appears to hold, e.g. "Add tops, add bottoms" (§2.4).

remediation_target.description: skill_id of the graph node that gets re-taught when this misconception is confirmed (§2.4). Remediation escalates: micro-explainer first, full prerequisite re-teaching only if the pattern persists.

remediation_asset.description: Pointer to the ~30-second micro-explainer (animation or interactive) addressing exactly this misconception (§2.4).

parent_summary_i18n.description: Plain-language rendering for parent/teacher reports, keyed by language (§2.4, §2.8), e.g. en-IN. May use {{name}} for the child's name.
